# Runic v0.1.0-alpha.8 - Table of Contents

> Powerful workflow graph composition and runtime for Elixir

## Modules

- [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Adaptive](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Adaptive.md): Self-tuning scheduler that adjusts dispatch strategy based on runtime profiling.
- [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Adaptive.Capability](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Adaptive.Capability.md): A registered dispatch capability that the Adaptive scheduler can assign to nodes.
- [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Adaptive.NodeProfile](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Adaptive.NodeProfile.md): Per-node execution statistics tracked by the Adaptive scheduler.
- [Runic.Workflow.Activator](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Activator.md): Optional protocol for nodes with custom downstream activation patterns.
- [Runic.Workflow.CausalContext](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.CausalContext.md): Minimal immutable context for executing a runnable without the full workflow.
- [Runic.Workflow.CompilationUtils](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.CompilationUtils.md): Macro utilities for compiling expressions into workflow graphs or components.

- [Runic.Workflow.ComponentAdded](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.ComponentAdded.md)
- [Runic.Workflow.ConditionRef](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.ConditionRef.md): A lightweight compile-time placeholder for referencing named conditions in rule `where` clauses.
- [Runic.Workflow.Conjunction](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Conjunction.md): Logical AND gate that requires all referenced conditions to be satisfied.
- [Runic.Workflow.Coordinator](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Coordinator.md): Optional protocol for nodes that need post-fold coordination.
- [Runic.Workflow.EventApplicator](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.EventApplicator.md): Protocol for applying custom events to a workflow.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.md): Barrel module for all workflow event types.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.ActivationConsumed](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.ActivationConsumed.md): Event emitted when a node consumes its activation edge (marks it as :ran).
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.ConditionSatisfied](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.ConditionSatisfied.md): Event emitted when a condition (or conjunction) is satisfied by a fact.

- [Runic.Workflow.Events.FactProduced](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.FactProduced.md): Event emitted when a fact is produced during workflow execution.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.FanInCompleted](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.FanInCompleted.md): Event derived during `maybe_finalize_coordination/2` when a FanIn node
determines that all expected fan-out items have been processed.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.FanOutFactEmitted](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.FanOutFactEmitted.md): Event emitted when a FanOut node splits an enumerable input into individual facts.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.JoinCompleted](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.JoinCompleted.md): Derived event emitted when a Join node has all required branches satisfied.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.JoinEdgeRelabeled](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.JoinEdgeRelabeled.md): Derived event emitted when a join edge is relabeled upon join completion.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.JoinFactReceived](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.JoinFactReceived.md): Event emitted when a fact arrives at a Join node from a parent branch.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.MapReduceTracked](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.MapReduceTracked.md): Event emitted when a step in a fan-out pipeline tracks its result
for downstream fan-in coordination.

- [Runic.Workflow.Events.RunnableActivated](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.RunnableActivated.md): Event emitted when a downstream node is activated by a produced fact.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.Serializer](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.Serializer.md): Serialization utilities for workflow events.
- [Runic.Workflow.Events.StateInitiated](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Events.StateInitiated.md): Event emitted when an accumulator initializes its state for the first time.
- [Runic.Workflow.FactRef](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.FactRef.md): A lightweight reference to a Fact without its value.
- [Runic.Workflow.FactResolver](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.FactResolver.md): Runtime resolver that hydrates `FactRef` structs via a Store adapter.
- [Runic.Workflow.Facts](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Facts.md): Unified accessors for `Fact` and `FactRef` structs.
- [Runic.Workflow.HookEvent](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.HookEvent.md): Event struct passed to hooks during execution.
- [Runic.Workflow.HookRunner](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.HookRunner.md): Runs hooks during the execute phase without requiring workflow access.
- [Runic.Workflow.ReactionOccurred](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.ReactionOccurred.md)
- [Runic.Workflow.Rehydration](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Rehydration.md): Lineage classification and hybrid rehydration for checkpointed workflows.
- [Runic.Workflow.Root](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Root.md)
- [Runic.Workflow.Serializer](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Serializer.md): Behaviour for workflow serialization to various graph formats.
- [Runic.Workflow.Serializers.Cytoscape](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Serializers.Cytoscape.md): Serializes Runic Workflows to Cytoscape.js JSON element format.
- [Runic.Workflow.Serializers.DOT](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Serializers.DOT.md): Serializes Runic Workflows to DOT (Graphviz) format.
- [Runic.Workflow.Serializers.Edgelist](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Serializers.Edgelist.md): Serializes Runic Workflows to simple edgelist format.
- [Runic.Workflow.Serializers.Mermaid](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Serializers.Mermaid.md): Serializes Runic Workflows to Mermaid diagram format.

- Core
  - [Runic](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.md): 
  - [Runic.Workflow](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.md): Runtime evaluation engine for Runic workflows.

- Components
  - [Runic.Workflow.Accumulator](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Accumulator.md): Accumulator components aggregate values over time using a reducer function.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Aggregate](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Aggregate.md): A CQRS/Event Sourcing aggregate component that validates commands, emits domain events, and folds events into state.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Condition](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Condition.md): Condition nodes are predicate checks that gate flow in a workflow.
  - [Runic.Workflow.FSM](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.FSM.md): A finite state machine component with discrete named states and event-driven transitions.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Join](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Join.md)
  - [Runic.Workflow.Map](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Map.md): Map operations contain a FanOut operator and LambdaStep operations to produce facts split from the input and process each.
  - [Runic.Workflow.ProcessManager](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.ProcessManager.md): An event-driven process orchestrator that coordinates across multiple aggregates.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Reduce](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Reduce.md): Component represention of a reduce operation to implement the component protocol
for connecting a reduce to other components in a workflow.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Rule](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Rule.md)
  - [Runic.Workflow.Saga](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Saga.md): A sequential transaction pipeline with compensating actions for failure recovery.
  - [Runic.Workflow.StateMachine](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.StateMachine.md): A stateful workflow component that combines an accumulator with reactive rules.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Step](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Step.md): Step nodes transform input facts into output facts.

- Scheduling &amp; Execution
  - [Runic.Workflow.PolicyDriver](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.PolicyDriver.md): Executes a `%Runnable{}` according to a `%SchedulerPolicy{}`, handling retries,
timeouts, backoff, fallbacks, and failure modes.
  - [Runic.Workflow.RunnableCompleted](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.RunnableCompleted.md): Event recording that a runnable completed execution successfully.
  - [Runic.Workflow.RunnableDispatched](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.RunnableDispatched.md): Event recording that a runnable was dispatched for execution.
  - [Runic.Workflow.RunnableFailed](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.RunnableFailed.md): Event recording that a runnable failed permanently (retries exhausted).
  - [Runic.Workflow.SchedulerPolicy](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.SchedulerPolicy.md): Defines per-node scheduling policies for workflow execution.

- Runner
  - [Runic.Runner](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.md): Built-in workflow execution infrastructure.
  - [Runic.Runner.Executor](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Executor.md): Behaviour for controlling how runnables are dispatched to compute.
  - [Runic.Runner.Executor.GenStage](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Executor.GenStage.md): GenStage-based executor providing demand-driven dispatch with back-pressure.
  - [Runic.Runner.Executor.Task](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Executor.Task.md): Default executor using `Task.Supervisor.async_nolink`.
  - [Runic.Runner.Promise](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Promise.md): A batched execution unit that groups runnables for optimized dispatch.
  - [Runic.Runner.PromiseBuilder](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.PromiseBuilder.md): Analyzes workflow graphs to construct Promises from linear chain patterns.
  - [Runic.Runner.Scheduler](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.md): Behaviour for controlling what gets dispatched together and when.
  - [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.ChainBatching](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.ChainBatching.md): Scheduler strategy that batches linear chains into Promises.
  - [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.ContractTest](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.ContractTest.md): Conformance test suite for `Runic.Runner.Scheduler` behaviour implementations.
  - [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Default](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.Default.md): Default scheduler strategy that dispatches each runnable individually.
  - [Runic.Runner.Scheduler.FlowBatch](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Scheduler.FlowBatch.md): Scheduler strategy that detects both sequential chains and parallel batch
opportunities.
  - [Runic.Runner.Store](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Store.md): Behaviour for workflow persistence adapters.
  - [Runic.Runner.Store.ETS](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Store.ETS.md): Default in-memory persistence adapter using ETS.
  - [Runic.Runner.Store.Mnesia](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Store.Mnesia.md): Mnesia-backed persistence adapter for the Runner.
  - [Runic.Runner.Telemetry](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Telemetry.md): Telemetry event definitions for Runic.Runner.
  - [Runic.Runner.Worker](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Runner.Worker.md): GenServer managing a single workflow's execution lifecycle.

- Protocols
  - [Runic.Component](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Component.md): Protocol defining how Runic components compose together and connect within workflows.
  - [Runic.Transmutable](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Transmutable.md): Protocol for converting data structures into Runic workflows or components.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Invokable](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Invokable.md): Protocol defining how workflow nodes execute within a workflow context.

- Internal
  - [Runic.Closure](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Closure.md): Serializable closure representation for Runic components.
  - [Runic.ClosureMetadata](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.ClosureMetadata.md): Serializable metadata for reconstructing closures from logs.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Components](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Components.md)
  - [Runic.Workflow.Fact](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Fact.md)
  - [Runic.Workflow.FanIn](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.FanIn.md): FanIn steps are part of a reduce operator that combines multiple facts into a single fact
by applying the reducer function to return the accumulator with the parent.
  - [Runic.Workflow.FanOut](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.FanOut.md): FanOut steps are part of a map operator that expands enumerable facts into separate facts.
  - [Runic.Workflow.Runnable](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.Workflow.Runnable.md): A prepared unit of work ready for execution.

- Exceptions
  - [Runic.IncompatiblePortError](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.IncompatiblePortError.md): Raised when connecting two components with incompatible port contracts.
  - [Runic.UnresolvedReferenceError](https://runic.hexdocs.pm/Runic.UnresolvedReferenceError.md): Raised when a component references another component that does not exist in the workflow.
